frozen_hypothesis: Does loosening safe-3's and risky-1's gate_override (min_triggers 2 -> 1, OR require_confluence_or_sequence true -> false) recover a material share of the $4,354.92 this window attributes to that gate, WITHOUT a proportional increase in losing entries that the tighter gate was itself installed to filter out (accounts.json's own grid docs frame the tight gate as the deliberate selectivity axis of the safe x tight / risky x FULL-SEND cells -- loosening it is not a free lunch, it is trading selectivity for participation)?

the_exact_knob.note: accounts.json is in FROZEN_TRADING_PATH -- this prereg does NOT apply the change; it is a proposal for the conductor to apply on 2026-10-30 IF the packet reads RULE MET.

kill_criterion: At the 2026-10-30 checkpoint, if the forward window (2026-09-05 -> 10-30) of analysis/right-tail/ledger.jsonl shows fewer than 10 new GATE-mechanism missed waves for safe-3+risky-1 combined (i.e. the gate is not the ongoing bottleneck it was in the backfill window), OR if applying either loosened setting in a dry-run replay against the SAME forward window's core-decisions.jsonl shows the loosened gate would have ALSO admitted a majority-losing cohort (bootstrap CI-lower(2.5%) of the newly-admitted trades' P&L <= 0), this prereg is KILLED -- gate stays as-is.
extend_criterion: If the forward window shows >=10 new GATE-mechanism missed waves for this slice AND a dry-run replay of the loosened setting against those same forward ticks shows a positive-or-neutral CI-lower(2.5%) for the newly-admitted cohort, this becomes a 2026-10-30 checkpoint SHIP candidate for the conductor.
reversible_action: Revert: set gate_override.min_triggers back to 2 / require_confluence_or_sequence back to true on the changed arm(s) -- one-line, byte-identical revert, matches the pattern of every other gate_override edit already documented in accounts.json.
does_this_ship_anything: No. accounts.json is untouched by this fire. This is a frozen proposal only.

evidence_2026_09_05_net_of_losers.source: analysis/gate-net-cost/GATE-NET-COST-2026-09-05.json (N3 net table, walked from analysis/gate-net-cost/walk-2026-09-05.json N2, 305/355 walk_ok)
evidence_2026_09_05_net_of_losers.definition: winner := realized_if_taken_dollars > 0; loser := realized_if_taken_dollars <= 0; net := sum(realized_if_taken_dollars) over walk_ok rows == winners + losers.
caveats: 5-min OPRA resolution bias: the walk (setup/scripts/gate_net_cost_walk.py) prices most refused ticks off 5-min-cached OPRA bars (a 1-min hand-check subset is within 10% of real fills, see backtest/tests/test_gate_net_cost_walk_2026_09_05.py); exact stage timing/price for any single row can be off by up to one 5-min bar.

50 of 355 refused rows are walk_error (fail-open, not fabricated): 36 have no usable side on the source decision row (side=None, a real data gap) and 14 have no cached OPRA contract near the target strike -- excluded from every $ figure below, not zero-filled.

Winner/loser $ uses realized_if_taken_dollars (the walked exit price), NOT the peak_multiple >= 1.3x ceiling N1/right-tail work used -- a wave can peak above 1.3x and still reverse before the walked exit stage fires; n_waves_peak_ge_1p3x is reported alongside as the alternate/ceiling metric so the two are never conflated.

Net figures are PROXY, not a ratifying replay: the same class of proxy caveat gate_expiry_check.py's own sole-blocker checks (filter-8/filter-10) carry -- this is a counterfactual walk through the arm's real exit shape, not a full gate-stack re-simulation.

frozen_window.combined_verdict: UNDERPOWERED (both gates n<10 waves in the frozen window)

evidence_2026_09_05_net_of_losers.reading: The $4,354.92 refused-WINNER ceiling this prereg was filed on (safe-3+risky-1 gate_override slice) nets to $-1,290.00 full-window once the gate's refused LOSERS are walked through the real exit shape: min_triggers alone is COSTING (+$516, 20 waves) but require_confluence_or_sequence alone is EARNING (-$1,806, 13 waves) -- the two knobs this prereg proposes loosening TOGETHER point in opposite directions net-of-losers. The frozen window (08-31 onward) is UNDERPOWERED for both (n=3, n=2 waves) -- too few waves since the config freeze to read a verdict; the full-window combined net is negative (EARNING/saved money) mainly because require_confluence_or_sequence's losers outweigh its winners. This does not kill the prereg (kill/extend criteria are unchanged, frozen text above) -- it is new evidence for the 2026-10-30 checkpoint read, appended per this goal's DONE-WHEN.
